title: The Best of Wodehouse

vibeProfile.oneLine: The best of the funniest writer in the English language.

summary: A generous selection of P. G. Wodehouse's finest comic writing, gathering the immortal Jeeves and Wooster and other inhabitants of his sunlit, scrape-prone England where the worst that can happen is a stern aunt or a lost engagement. Wodehouse's prose is a marvel of perfectly balanced sentences and gleeful absurdity, and this collection is the ideal way to meet the funniest writer in the language. Pure, blissful escapism from a master of the comic form.
whyReadIt: The funniest writer in English, gathered in one volume. Pure, blissful, perfectly crafted escapism.

funFacts.text: Wodehouse's mastery of the comic sentence made even fellow writers despair of matching him.
